summary: Highly capable Software Engineer with expertise in building scalable backend systems and optimizing database performance, ideal for an Associate Software Engineer role. Proven ability to deliver robust solutions across multi-tenant architectures and complex data management scenarios.

projects.name: PayStride
projects.subtitle: Multi-Tenant SaaS Payroll Management System
projects.tech: Java, Spring Boot, MySQL, Hibernate, REST API, JWT
bullets: Architected multi-tenant RBAC system using Spring Security and JWT, enforcing complete data isolation across all API endpoints.
Optimized MySQL query execution through strategic indexing and schema normalization, reducing average response latency by 40%.
Engineered BigDecimal payroll computation engine handling statutory deductions (PF 12%, ESI 0.75%) and 1.5x overtime multipliers with zero precision loss.

projects.name: EduTrack
projects.subtitle: Student Management Portal
projects.tech: Java, Spring Boot, MongoDB, REST API
bullets: Developed RESTful CRUD APIs over Spring Boot handling 500+ student records with optimized MongoDB aggregation queries.
Designed modular service architecture enabling independent scaling of student, batch, and reporting modules.
Implemented dual-layer validation (client-side and server-side) reducing data entry errors by 25%.

projects.name: Customised Virtual File System (CVFS)
projects.subtitle: In-Memory Linux-like File Manager
projects.tech: C, C++, Data Structures, OS Concepts
bullets: Simulated Linux file system operations (open, read, write, lseek) in C++ using inode-based metadata management and a custom shell interpreter.
Achieved O(1) file lookup by designing hash table-based inode indexing with chaining for collision resolution.
Implemented in-memory file allocation table using C++ classes managing file permissions, ownership, and hierarchical directory traversal.
